name: dermobridge-web
description: Dermatology Bridge — Clinician decision-support web client (Phase 0 skeleton; UI built in Phase 5)

scripts.dev: node -e "const http=require('http');const s=http.createServer((_,res)=>{res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':'application/json'});res.end(JSON.stringify({status:'phase-0-skeleton',disclaimer:'For clinician review — not a diagnosis.'}));});s.listen(3000,()=>console.log('dermobridge-web Phase 0 skeleton listening on http://localhost:3000'));"
scripts.build: echo "Phase 0 skeleton — Next.js App Router UI scheduled for Phase 5"
